question: I’m researching species that became invasive after people who kept them as pets released them. There’s a certain species of fish that was popularized as a pet by being the main character of the movie Finding Nemo. According to the USGS, where was this fish found as a nonnative species, before the year 2020? I need the answer formatted as the five-digit zip codes of the places the species was found, separated by commas if there is more than one place.

mistake_reason: At step 4, WebSurfer accessed the USGS NAS Amphiprion ocellaris page and observed the precise locality details but withheld them from the team, providing only a vague summary of "Tampa Bay area (Pinellas County)" instead of the specific city (Tarpon Springs) and its corresponding data. This information withholding (FM-2.4) prevented downstream agents from mapping to the correct zip code (34689) and led FileSurfer and Assistant to infer a generic central Pinellas zip (33701), resulting in the wrong final answer.
